input.overview: Aquarius scores through its upper saucers and lit center pop bumper. Plunge for a 300-point saucer whose kickout stays in the bumpers, then use gentle nudges to create saucer-to-bumper-to-saucer loops. Shoot around the outside of the bumpers from the flippers and avoid the lower standups.
input.simpleOverview: In Aquarius, plunge for one of the right-side 300-point saucers. Find the saucer whose kickout stays up top, then nudge rebounds back into it. From a flipper, shoot around the outside of the bumpers. Avoid the lower standup targets even though completing 1–12 can light Special.
input.summary: A lower-value saucer with a repeatable upper kickout is better than a 300-point saucer that throws the ball toward the drains. Use the 200-point saucer when it feeds the center bumper and returns the ball toward another hole.

quickInfo.name: Saucers
quickInfo.summary: Each hole spots its corresponding number and scores the shown value.

quickInfo.name: Repeatable kickout
quickInfo.summary: Favor the saucer that returns the ball into a bumper or another saucer instead of sending it below.

quickInfo.name: Center pop bumper
quickInfo.summary: Worth more when lit and can send a 200-point saucer kickout back toward the holes.

quickInfo.name: Complete 1 through 12
quickInfo.summary: Lights Special, but the lower standups needed for completion carry heavy drain risk.

steps.text: Plunge for one of the two rightmost 300-point saucers and watch its kickout.
Identify the saucer that returns the ball toward the upper bumpers or another saucer.
Use gentle nudges to turn bumper rebounds into repeat entries of that safe saucer.
From either flipper, shoot outside the nearest bumper to return the ball up top.
Ignore the lower standups unless a nearly complete 1–12 sequence makes Special worth the drain risk.

buildsToward.title: A repeatable saucer and bumper loop

steps.text: Nudge its rebound toward another saucer.
Return to the upper playfield whenever the ball reaches a flipper.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play and whether completing 1–12 awards Special, replay, or a points conversion under tournament settings.
Plunge or hand-test every saucer kickout, then verify all 1–12 spot lamps, the center pop-bumper lamp and value, upper bumper strength, and lower standup rebounds.
